domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready form by matching denominators and/or normalizing whole or mixed numbers so like parts can be subtracted.
skills.merge_rationale: S01 and S02 are both preparatory alignment skills that occur before the main subtraction. In the dossiers, both serve the same problem-solving phase: making operands compatible for subtraction. They are distinct at fine grain, but at a coarser level they can be merged without losing the major diagnostic distinction between preparation, execution, regrouping, and finalization.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the main subtraction once operands are in compatible form, including subtracting like-denominator fractions and/or whole and fractional parts separately.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because it is the core execution step and has distinct error patterns from preparation, borrowing, and finalization.

skills.name: Regroup during subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup across whole and fractional parts when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to complete the subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because borrowing is a distinctive mixed-number subtraction difficulty with strong diagnostic value and different common errors than ordinary subtraction.

skills.name: Finalize and express result
skills.definition: Simplify the computed result and express it in the appropriate final form, including combining whole and fractional parts or reducing to 0 when needed.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification/recombination is a finalization phase with its own error patterns and should remain distinguishable from computation.
